note: Loading-screen tips (data-driven). Every tip describes a control or mechanic that exists in THIS game; add localisation keys later.
tips: Press H to select your Town Center and jump the camera to it.
Press . (period) to select an idle villager. Press it again to cycle through them.
Hold Shift while giving orders to queue them one after another.
Ctrl + a number key creates a control group. Press the number to recall it, twice to centre the camera on it.
F1, F2 and F3 select your military, economy and tech buildings. Press again to cycle through them.
TAB cycles through the unit types of a mixed selection.
Backspace centres the camera on your selection.
Space jumps the camera to the last place you were attacked.
Alt + mouse movement rotates the camera. Ctrl + Q / E rotates it with the keyboard.
Keep your Town Center producing villagers: a strong economy wins long games.
Garrison villagers in a building or ring the Town Bell when raiders arrive.
Advancing to the next Age unlocks new buildings, units and technologies.
Double-click a unit to select every unit of the same type on screen.
All keyboard shortcuts can be changed in Settings > Controls.
